definitions: A fictional character from the Chinese web novel 'A Will Eternal' by Er Gen.
She is often depicted as a beautiful and talented cultivator, known for her intelligence and strong personality.
examples: Chu Yuyan was a formidable presence.
The story often revolved around Chu Yuyan's decisions.
synonyms: Bai Xiaochun's love interest (in 'A Will Eternal')
Disciple of the Blood Stream Sect (in 'A Will Eternal')
